text:
Before the lights come on,
this is where people wait 🌸

A warm greenhouse full of hanging begonias
at Nabana no Sato, near Nagoya.

Its winter light tunnel is 200 m long,
and this year it runs until 31 May 2027.

One Japan spot a day on our page ✨
